tips.text: Do one unhurried run for the collectibles and a separate throwaway run for the under-15-minutes and Deathless challenges.
Buy each component the week its rank unlocks and start its 12-hour build, so only the 72-hour final build is left after week four.
Follow the minimap radar for collectibles instead of searching the map by hand.
For the under-15-minutes challenge, sprint, roll and slide, skip optional objectives and avoid combat.
Against the Raknoid, shoot the LN2 barrels to freeze it, grenade it for the heat proc, then use the Plasma Torch.
Check your inventory first; older accounts were given Styanax free in past promotions.
On a busy week, just finish the mission for the rank and make up the Stock later with crate replays.
In Sneaky Sabotage, blitz past Deacons; their detection fills slowly.
Use the Veilbreaker grenade to stun Deacons and the Scyto Raknoid while you line up the Plasma Torch.
Finish a mission area's challenges before the point of no return: the Raknoid arena door in Sneaky Sabotage, boarding the Bolkor in Prison Break.
In Sneaky Sabotage, dying is fine for a speed run since it does not fail the mission, but it ruins Deathless.
Run the Prison Break speed run as its own run; walking back after the boss may not keep the time credit.
If Junk Run's Sprag arena locks with the shock mine unarmed, jump to the top of the doorway and have your brothers re-arm it.
Shake off any Deacon that is hunting you before the Veilbreak prompt; an aware Deacon blocks it.
Players call Break Narmer one of the most tedious parts of the game, mostly for the Veilbreaker gate and the under-15-minutes challenge.
Expect four calendar weeks plus the three-day build, at about 20 to 45 minutes of play per week.
